Service agreement between Acme Ltd and Birch Analytics, 2026

## Parties
This agreement is between Acme Ltd, the client, and Birch Analytics, the provider.

## Services
The provider delivers a monthly sales report and answers data questions within two working days.

## Fees
The client pays 1,350 EUR per month, invoiced on the first working day of the month.

## Termination
Either party may end this agreement with 60 days' written notice.

## Confidentiality
Both parties keep the other's data confidential during the agreement and for two years after it.
